source_snapshot.test_name_items: All HDD Slot Number Check - NVMe
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check if NVMe via NVMe adapter slot number is correctly

1. Insert all NVMe SSD into BP slot and check slot number

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. Check system spec define slot number

deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: Claims device/serial/slot mapping for all HDD.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; collects identities but incorrectly treats volatile `/dev/nvmeX` order as physical slot evidence and omits insertion.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds authoritative slot source, serial population, physical placement, firmware/BMC/PCIe correlation and safety.

original_test_intent: Populate every approved backplane NVMe slot and prove that each physical bay number maps to the correct SSD serial through the NVMe adapter according to the platform specification.
original_method: A qualified operator inserts serial-identified SSDs into documented physical bays and records placement; the agent correlates an authoritative BIOS/BMC/backplane/vendor slot identifier with PCIe topology and complete nvme-cli/OS identities.
manual_activity: The source requires placing every SSD into a physical backplane slot and checking that physical slot number. OS enumeration cannot perform or prove placement, so this is MANUAL ONLY.
required_inputs: Authoritative chassis/backplane slot numbering and adapter-port topology
Complete SSD model/serial/firmware population and intended bay
Insertion power state, hot-plug/ESD/carrier procedure and order
Authoritative BIOS/BMC/vendor field that reports physical slot
Operator photos/labels plus PCIe/NVMe inventory method
safety_requirements: Confirm all drives are approved and not boot, protected, data-bearing or unknown before insertion.
Use documented bay power state and ESD/mechanical handling.
Never infer physical slot from `/dev/nvmeX` or namespace order, which may change across boots.
Do not initialize, format, mount or write the drives.
Stop on duplicate serial, missing/ambiguous slot, link/power/thermal fault or topology mismatch; no automatic reseat.
agent_execution_scope: Validate the expected serial-to-bay map and collect baseline topology.
After operator population, capture authoritative slot fields, PCIe paths and full NVMe controller/namespace identities.
Produce a one-to-one correlation table and flag duplicates/missing/ambiguous mappings.
Report Tool Result without claiming insertion or formal verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve and physically install every SSD into its specified bay.
Record physical labels/placement and confirm the authoritative slot-number source.
Resolve mapping discrepancies and issue PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Read-only but insufficient: device names are not physical slots, `ls /dev/nvme*` mixes controllers/namespaces, and `head -30` may omit required identity fields.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use untruncated nvme-cli and PCIe topology plus documented BIOS/BMC/backplane/vendor slot identifiers, joined by serial and stable device path.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All-drive insertion, NVMe adapter slot-number check and 15/8-minute fields are retained.

modernized_recommendation.status: PHYSICAL POPULATION PLUS AUTHORITATIVE TOPOLOGY JOIN
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Generate a manifest joining chassis bay, backplane port, adapter port, PCIe path, controller serial and namespace identity, with operator photos of every labeled bay.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact chassis/backplane, adapter topology and NVMe population.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC, adapter/backplane firmware, kernel/driver and nvme-cli versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform slot-number and PCIe/NVMe population specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds a durable cross-layer map without replacing physical placement.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; makes all-slot coverage explicit.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Linux controller indexes and namespaces are enumeration artifacts, not chassis labels.

project_override_considerations: The project defines the population and authoritative slot namespace. Completion must enumerate every tested physical bay and cannot claim unpopulated slots.
expected_evidence: Approved slot map, SSD serial population and safe insertion plan
Authoritative firmware/BMC/vendor slot output, PCIe topology and full NVMe identity
Correlation table, event/health logs, Tool Result and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and criterion consistently require specification-defined slot numbers; the authoritative source is missing but not contradictory.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The intent is clear. Mapping and population are readiness inputs, while execution remains manual at its physical core.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects YES and volatile device order as proof of slot number.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains authoritative mapping and operator evidence; applies MANUAL ONLY under V3.1.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Requires a one-to-one all-population correlation and untruncated identity evidence.

review_improvement: Prevents OS enumeration order from being mistaken for physical bay numbering.
independent_technical_reasoning: Slot-number validation depends on human placement and physical labels. Automated inventory can join identities only after that physical truth is recorded, so it cannot own the core acceptance.
no_automatic_retry: Do not rescan, renumber, reboot or reseat drives automatically after mapping mismatch. Preserve the topology and escalate.
